short: The signed-in area behind the session gate
is: The signed-in area — a group layout that bounces anonymous visitors to `/login` and wraps every page in the Explorer frame (the My Den tree beside the pane), containing My Den (`den/`), the account screens and the logout action; its errors render inside the frame.
conventions: The sign-in gate is the server `handle` hook (`lib/server/session-gate.ts`): no `(session)` load, data request (whatever loads it asks to skip) or form action runs without a session — except the sign-out action, which reads nothing and must clear the browser's session even when the backend is down. The group layout's redirect only narrows the type. The backend still checks the session on every call.
New signed-in routes JOIN this group rather than re-implementing the check.
Detail pages derive from the caller's own listing — there is no fetch-by-id rpc in v1; destructive actions require typed confirmation (WCAG 3.3.4).
Each page's load returns `trail` (App.PageData) for the frame's path bar; the frame itself reads nothing from the backend.
The sidebar, the drawer and every way into My Den appear only when the root layout's `denServed` is true (the mock today); the everyday stack shows the top bar and the pane only.

fs.name: +error.svelte
fs.role: errors inside the frame, by status and route alone (ErrorView) — a failed sign-out says so; the error's message is never read

fs.name: +layout.server.ts
fs.role: hands the frame the session (the hook already refused anyone without one; the redirect here only narrows the type)

fs.name: +layout.svelte
fs.role: the Explorer frame (AppShell) around every signed-in page: the path from the page's `trail`; the My Den tree and the View options in the sidebar, fed by the frame's tree memory (never stored; started over on a flag flip, and on a form action's success, which the page that ran it reports, keeping `~` open); after each navigation the drawer closes and any open folder the tree lacks is fetched

fs.name: accounts/
fs.role: listing + create action; [id]/ detail with typed-handle delete confirmation

fs.name: den/
fs.role: My Den: `[...path]` serves /den and every Den path below it; on the everyday stack (no Den served) it is the ordinary 404 with no Den call (a signed-in visitor makes only the usual /me call). +page.server.ts is the only code that reads the Den (through lib/server/den.ts); +page.svelte is the right pane (DenPane) with in-place More (focus to the first new row), a one-place busy delay, heading focus, a generic title and a live region naming the opened item

fs.name: error.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: proves the in-frame error page never shows the error's message and that a failed sign-out says so ($app/state mocked)

fs.name: layout.server.spec.ts
fs.role: spec for the gate — anonymous redirects, signed-in passes the session through

fs.name: layout.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: the frame around a signed-in page with real styles ($app/state and afterNavigate mocked): banner + main + path, Accounts current, Sign out in the top bar, skip link first, drawer closes on navigation, one Accounts in the drawer, no sideways scroll at 320 px

fs.name: logout/
fs.role: an action, not a page — a stray GET goes home; the action always clears zurfur.sid, mirrors the backend's clears when it confirms, and otherwise lands on /login?signout=unconfirmed

refs.title: The Den — a Tree of Typed Files, Peer Views and Atta
refs.governs: `den/` and the frame's tree: one node shape rendered, never decided, by the web
